v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Ámplius lava me, * Dómine, ab iniustítia mea.
text.en: O Lord, wash me * yet more from my iniquity.
O Lord, * thou wilt pardon our transgressions.

text.la: In innocéntia * cordis mei perambulábo, Dómine.
text.en: I walked in the innocence * of my heart, O Lord.

text.la: Exsultávit cor meum * in Dómino, qui humíliat et súblevat.
text.en: My heart hath rejoiced * in the Lord, he humbleth and he exalteth.

text.la: Lauda * ánima mea Dóminum, qui érigit elísos et díligit iustos.
text.en: Praise * the Lord my soul, he lifts up those who fall, and loves the just.

text.la: Veníte, mittámus lignum in panem eius, et eradámus eum de terra vivéntium, et nomen eius non memorétur ámplius.
text.en: Come, let us put wood on his bread, and cut him off from the land of the living, and let his name be remembered no more.

v.la: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus.
v.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God.

r.la: Et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
r.en: And defend me from them that rise up against me.

text.la: Oves meæ * vocem meam áudiunt: et ego Dóminus agnósco eas.
text.en: My sheep hear My voice, * and I, the Lord, know them.

text.la: Sanctificáto hoc ieiúnio Deus, tuórum corda fidélium miserátor illústra: et, quibus devotiónis præstas afféctum, præbe supplicántibus pium benígnus audítum.
text.en: O God, be mercifully pleased, through the hallowing of this Fast, to shed light upon the hearts of thy faithful people, and since Thou hast given them the mind to pray, let thy pitiful ears be opened graciously to hear their supplications.

text.la: Euge, serve bone et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Deus, qui Ecclésiam tuam beáti Vincéntii Confessóris tui méritis et prædicatióne illustráre dignátus es: concéde nobis fámulis tuis; ut et ipsíus instruámur exémplis et ab ómnibus eius patrocínio liberémur advérsis.
text.en: O God, Who wast pleased to enlighten thy Church through the worthy deeds and Gospel preaching of thy blessed Confessor Vincent, grant unto us thy servants grace so to order our lives after his example, that we, being helped by his protection, may by thee be ever delivered from all evil.
